Name: Sekun's Soaps
Author: RiftstalkerSekun
Description:
Have you wondered that maybe the Oil Maker was under-utilized? Or maybe have tons of Hardwood that just sits around, collecting dust? Ever thought that maybe the game was missing a new cutesy collection of artisan goods? Or maybe you just wanted a simple way to do some chill, low maintenance farming and crafting and still make respectable money at the end of the season? Or perhaps just one small, standalone mod with a single focus? Then this mod is for you!

Soapmaking is an age-old tradition and craft with a long and storied history, but no one came here to read a wiki article, so we'll jump to the important parts. To start, you need a few things, some Lye, some kind of Oil, and a Soap Pot. 
Lye is easy. Put a piece of Hardwood into your Charcoal Kiln, wait two hours, and you'll get one bottle of Lye for your troubles. 
A Soap Pot is also fairly straightforward. You learn the crafting recipe automatically upon reaching level 4 Farming, and crafting a Soap Pot requires 2 Iron Bar, 10 Hardwood, 1 Clay, and 1 Battery Pack.
Oils are used along with Lye in a Soap Pot to make various soaps. Similar to Coal for smelting metals, you need one bottle of Lye to make a single soap in the Soap Pot, and there are quite a few different ways to get oils. You can either explore and get letters in the mail after shipping certain items that will explain the different oils to you, or you could read the spoiler down below.

[spoiler] 
Oil: Regular base-game Oil, either purchased from Pierre or made on your own.
Milk: Regular-sized Cow or Goat Milk can be used along with Lye to make a milk soap. Doesn't work with Big Milks, though.
Coconut Oil: Put a Coconut into the Oil Maker to get two Coconut Oil in return.
Orange Oil: Put an Orange into the Oil Maker and get an Orange Oil out of it.
Sweet Almond Oil: Buy a Sweet Almond sapling from Pierre, grow it into a tree, and harvest Sweet Almonds in the Spring to press for oil in the Oil Maker
Shea Butter: Buy a Shea Nut sapling from Pierre, grow it into a tree, and harvest Shea Nuts in the Summer to press for oil in the Oil Maker.
Frantoio Olive Oil: Buy a Frantoio Olive sapling from Pierre, grow it into a tree, and harvest Frantoio Olives in the Fall to press for oil in the Oil Maker.
Luxury Blended Oil: Ship a Sweet Almond Soap, Shea Butter Soap, and Frantoio Olive Soap to get the recipe for Luxury Blended Oil in the mail.
[/spoiler]﻿

It takes three hours for the Oil Maker to press one item into oil, and eight hours for the Soap Pot to turn the oil and lye into soap.
Confused by how you're supposed to get an Oil Maker before you learn the recipe at level 8 Farming? Don't worry, a friend will help you out with a letter at level 5 Farming.

If you've gotten this far down, thanks for reading! I hope you enjoy the mod and the cute little soaps. Have fun!
